subject: Starter pack retro credits & one-time discount request
messages:
From: Anna Patel <anna@orchardaccelerator.com>
To: rishi@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@orchardaccelerator.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Starter pack credit & onboarding pricing question

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency numbers and the dev experience looked great. We're finalizing the cohort roster for our winter cohort and want to include Redwood as the recommended inference provider for student teams. Two asks before we sign off:

1) Retroactive starter pack: a few cohort teams began pilots during an internal early-access window in June. Those usages were under our prior vendor agreement. Is there any way Redwood can provide a one-off credit to cover those June pilot costs so we can consolidate billing into a single onboarding package?

2) One-time onboarding discount: given we'll be recommending Redwood to ~25 teams (mostly early stage with sporadic burst usage), can we get a modest one-time discount on the first 6 months of committed Dedicated capacity? We understand standard program terms, but this would help internal approvals.

I've attached our standard SOW template and a short summary of cohort projects. Happy to hop on a quick call if it's easier.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Patel
Program Director, Orchard Accelerator
[Attachment: Orchard_SOW_v3.pdf]
From: rishi@redwood.com
To: Anna Patel <anna@orchardaccelerator.com>
Cc: ben@redwood.com, chloe@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Starter pack credit & onboarding pricing question

Anna — really appreciate the context and the invite to be the recommended provider. Congratulations on the cohort lineup. Quick notes below; looping in Ben (sales lead) and Chloe (finance/partner pricing) to propose a path that balances approval speed with internal guardrails.

Short answers:
- Retroactive credits: We can consider a carve-out for distributed pilot consumption, but we'll need usage logs and a short reconciliation period. If the cumulative June pilot spend is within a threshold, we can offer a one-time credit that offsets those charges and folds them into the cohort's starter pack.
- Onboarding discount: We're open to a tiered, volume-based discount for the first 6 months of Dedicated capacity for cohort teams, with a cap to protect unit economics.

Requested next steps from our side:
1) Anna: can you share the June usage export (CSV) and highlight which teams you want covered?
2) Ben/Chloe: we should propose (a) a credit amount calculation method and (b) a promotional pricing sheet with caps and opt-out clauses.

I'll keep this thread as the single source of truth so we have a clean audit trail for legal/finance.

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra | Senior AE | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RDW-pricing-summary-Aug2027.xlsx]
From: ben@redwood.com
To: Anna Patel <anna@orchardaccelerator.com>, rishi@redwood.com
Cc: chloe@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Starter pack credit & onboarding pricing question

Anna — thanks for the details and Rishi for the summary. From a commercial perspective, here's a proposal that keeps approvals straightforward while limiting downside for Redwood: 

Proposal (high level):
- Retro credit: For valid June pilot usage (teams you designate + matching usage logs), Redwood will issue a one-time credit equal to 80% of the recorded hosted inference charges, up to a program-level cap of $25,000. Credit will be applied to the cohort's first invoice.

- Starter pack onboarding discount: A 15% discount on the first 6 months of Dedicated capacity for the cohort portfolio, with the following guardrails:
  * Minimum cohort commit: aggregate 100k token-hours across teams for the 6-month window, OR a $30k minimum spend commitment to unlock the discount.
  * Discount cap: total discount not to exceed $40k.
  * Promo termination: Redwood reserves the right to sunset the promo after 90 days' notice for new cohorts.

We'd document this in an addendum to the standard SOW and require a short usage attestation from Orchard. If this looks reasonable, Chloe can draft the addendum and SOW language.

Notes on attachments: I uploaded a pricing summary and a sample addendum draft to the Drive link Rishi shared.

Ben Carter | Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
From: Anna Patel <anna@orchardaccelerator.com>
To: ben@redwood.com, rishi@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@orchardaccelerator.com
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 14:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Starter pack credit & onboarding pricing question

Ben / Rishi — this is great and moves quickly, thank you. Orchard accepts the commercial structure with two small asks:

1) Can the retro credit cap be raised to $30k given there are 6 teams with bursty GPU usage in June (we'll send logs).
2) For the 6-month discount, can we start the measurement window from cohort kickoff (we may have staggered onboarding for teams)?

If you can sign off on those two items, procurement will prepare a fast-track PO and we can attach the addendum to our SOW. I'll send the June usage export by EOD.

Best,
Anna
Program Director, Orchard Accelerator
